title: SS27 Kids' Trim Stories
summary: Trims that carry each SS27 kids' theme: flat seams for Pool Days, minimal details for Lull, characters for Happenstance and tape for Sailor Stripes.

sections.heading: Pool Days
sections.body: Flat seams, covered elastics, zip garages, printed labels.

sections.heading: Lull
sections.body: Tonal stitching, stripe trims, natural buttons; subtle details and clever contrasts<sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Happenstance
sections.body: Character embroidery, appliqué, novelty buttons and playful embellishment<sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Sailor Stripes
sections.body: Sailor collars, contrast tape, anchor-look buttons<sup>[2]</sup>.

design_implications:
- One trim family per theme.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
